input: Izuba ryarohamye munsi yizuba, ritanga urumuri rushyushye mumihanda yuzuye umujyi. Abantu bihutiye kunyura mu kayira kegereye umuhanda, ibirenge byabo byumvikana kuri kaburimbo igihe ibiganiro byavuzaga kwitotomba. Muri kafe, impumuro ya kawa nshya yatetse ivanze n'impumuro y'ibicuruzwa bitetse, ihamagarira abahisi guhagarara no kwinezeza. Abahanzi bo mumuhanda bongeyeho amajwi nindirimbo, mu kanya gato bahindura umujyi icyuma cyiza cyane cyamajwi. Umugoroba urangiye, amatara yo mu mujyi yahindutse ubuzima, amurikira imbyino zikomeye z'ubuzima bwo mu mijyi zitigeze zihagarara rwose.

Hirya no hino ahantu hanini cyane h’imisozi izunguruka n'amashyamba atoshye, umuyaga wongoreraga amabanga mu mababi. Inyamanswa zanyerera munsi yigitereko, ingendo zabo ballet icecekeye ikorwa munsi yijisho ryikirere. Umugezi wagendagendaga buhoro buhoro unyuze kuri ubwo butaka, ubuso bwacyo bugaragaza urumuri rw'izuba rwijimye kandi bigakora ibishushanyo bishimishije ijisho. Inyoni zaririmbye injyana zisa nkizivuga amateka yisi karemano, simfoni yubuzima yumvikanye muri quietude. Muri iyi miterere ituje, igihe cyasaga nkicyatinze, bigatuma ibihe byo gutekereza n'amahoro bitera imbere.

Imbere mu isomero rikuru, amasahani arambuye ubuziraherezo, yuzuye ibitabo bya buri kintu cyatekerezwa. Impumuro yimpapuro zishaje hamwe no guhambira uruhu byuzuye umwuka, bitumira abashakashatsi mubumenyi gucengera mwisi zitabarika. Abasomyi bicaye ahantu heza no kumeza yagutse, amaso yabo asikana impapuro mugihe ubwenge bwabo bwazengurukaga mubitekerezo, inkuru, nubuvumbuzi. Rimwe na rimwe, urusaku rwo guhindura impapuro rwatumaga hum ituje yibanda cyane. Hanze, isi yakomeje kwihuta, ariko murukuta, isanzure ryubwenge nibitekerezo byateye imbere muburyo butuje.

Ku isoko ryuzuye, abacuruzi bavugije induru amaturo yabo, bahatanira kwitabwaho hagati y’amajwi. Ahantu huzuye huzuye imbuto nziza, ibirungo bihumura neza, hamwe nimyenda y'amabara, buri kintu kivuga amateka yinkomoko nubukorikori. Abaguzi batitaye ku biciro no kungurana inkuru, bakora kaseti ishimishije ihuza abantu. Impumuro yinyama zasye hamwe nudukariso twiza twazungurukaga mu kirere, bikagerageza abahisi kwishira. Hagati y'akajagari, hari injyana ishingiyeho - impiswi yatumaga isoko ikomeza kubaho kandi ikagira imbaraga, bikaba byerekana umwuka uhoraho w'abaturage.

Ku nyanja nini, umuraba waguye hejuru y’ubwato, wohereza amazi y’umunyu mu kirere. Abakozi bagendanaga bafite intego, bahindura ubwato kandi bagenda banyuze mu kirere kinini cy'ubururu, bayobowe gusa n'inyenyeri hamwe n'ubushishozi. Ikirangantego cyarambuye ubuziraherezo, canvas yamabara ahindura kuva mugitondo kugeza bwije, byerekana ubwiza bwisi butagira umupaka. Inyanja yazengurutse hejuru, guhamagarwa kwabo kumvikana hejuru y'amazi, byiyongera kuri simfoniya y'amajwi y'inyanja. Nubwo inyanja yonyine, ibyiyumvo byo gutangaza no kuvumbura byateye imbere murwego rutagira iherezo.

Hagati ya parike yumujyi wuzuye, ibitwenge byabana byumvikanye mugihe bakinaga kuri swingi na slide. Imiryango yatoraguye ibiringiti ikwirakwira mu byatsi, isangira inkuru kandi yishimira kubana hagati yigitutu cyibiti birebire. Joggers hamwe nabatwara amagare bagendeye kumuhanda uhindagurika, ingendo zabo zitera injyana yibitekerezo byumutuzo wa kamere mubuzima bwumujyi. Imbwa n'ingurube byanyerera hejuru yicyuzi, byiyongera kuri ambiance y'amahoro. Umunsi urangiye, parike yahindutse oasisi ituje aho abatuye umujyi basanze baruhutse kubikorwa byabo byinshi.

Umusozi wimisozi watanze panorama ishimishije yibibaya bikikije nimpinga za kure. Abazamuka bazengurutse umuriro muto, basangira imigani y'urugendo rwabo n'inzozi z'ejo hazaza. Umwuka wari muto kandi utera imbaraga, wuzuza ibihaha umwuka mwiza wa ogisijeni. Urubura rwa shelegi rwatsimbaraye ahantu h'urutare, rukanyeganyega munsi y'izuba ryinshi, bitandukanye n'isi yijimye n'ibimera bito hepfo. Mugihe ibicu byatembaga kera, igicucu cyakinaga ahantu nyaburanga, gishimangira ubwiza bwubutaka. Uhagaze hejuru yisi, umuntu yumvise isano ikomeye nubwiza bwibihe bidashira.

Mu gace kegereye umujyi utuje, imiryango yagiye ikora gahunda zabo injyana yoroheje. Abana bakinaga hopscotch ku kayira kegereye umuhanda, ibitwenge byabo byumvikanira mu kirere ababyeyi bareba neza ku rubaraza rwegereye. Ubusitani bwarabye imvururu zamabara - roza, taleul, dais - byose bihatanira urumuri rwizuba no kwitabwaho. Impumuro y'ibyatsi bimaze gutemwa n'indabyo zirabya byaremye umwuka utumirwa ukubiyemo ibintu by'urugo. Umugoroba wazanye urumuri rworoheje rw'amatara yo kumuhanda no kumva ko ukomeje amahoro bikunze kutamenyekana ariko bikundwa cyane.

Amatongo ya kera yavugaga amateka yimico yashize, inkuta zabo zamabuye zarabaye ikirere ariko ziramba. Imizabibu na mususu byanyuze mu mwobo, byerekana uko ibihe byagiye bisimburana hamwe na kamere isubirana ibyo yaremye. Abashakashatsi bazengurutse mu mayira no mu gikari, batekereza ubuzima bwigeze kubaho muri izo nyubako. Guceceka kwari kwimbitse, guhagarikwa gusa nijwi ryintambwe no guhamagarwa kwinyoni kure. Igihe izuba ryarenze inyuma yamabuye, igicucu cyarambuye, gitanga umwuka wamayobera no kubaha kurubuga. Byari byibukije amateka yamara kubaho hamwe ninkuru zashizwe mumabuye yose.

Mu kibuga cy’indege cyuzuye, abagenzi bihutiye kera bumva ko bategereje kandi bifuza. Ibiziga by'imizigo byegeranye hasi hasi mugihe ibiganiro mu ndimi zitabarika byuzuye umwuka. Ibyerekezo bya digitale byerekanaga igihe cyo kugenda nigihe cyo kuhagera, kiyobora abagenzi batihangana cyangwa bashimishijwe berekeza iyo berekeza. Igikombe cya kawa hamwe nudupfunyika twa snack twuzuyemo impande zimwe, ibimenyetso byumuseke wihuse no kwitegura kumunota wanyuma. Hagati y'akajagari kateguwe, habaye ubwumvikane busangiwe - umwanya muto wo guhuza abantu batazi bahujwe nicyifuzo rusange cyo gushakisha, kugaruka, cyangwa gushaka intangiriro nshya. Urugendo rwahoraga rugiye gukomeza.

Ku kirwa cyiza cyane, imiraba yoroheje yakubise ku nkombe z'umusenyi nziza, zitumira kuruhuka no gutekereza. Ibiti by'imikindo byanyeganyega mu muyaga wo mu nyanja, siluettes zabo zinyuranye n'ikirere cya azure. Abagenda ku nyanja barogeje izuba, bubaka umusenyi, kandi bakusanya inyanja, bishora mu byishimo byoroshye bikubiyemo paradizo. Amazi yo mu mazi, amabuye meza ya korali yuzuye ubuzima bwamazi yo mu nyanja, agaragara binyuze mumazi meza yerekanaga isi yihishe yibitangaza. Umugoroba wegereje, utambitse twinshi twijimye kandi dufite ibara ry'umuhondo n'iroza, byerekana ko undi munsi urangiye muri iyi oasisi ituje. Ubwiza butuje bwizinga bwatanze ahera kure y urusaku rwubuzima bwa buri munsi.

Mu nyubako y'ibiro bigezweho, abakozi bafatanyaga mu byumba by'inama bikikijwe n'ibirahuri hamwe n'ahantu hakorerwa imirimo. Hum ya mudasobwa hamwe no kuvuza terefone byatumaga urusaku ruhoraho, ruhagarikwa no gukanda kanda ya clavier no guhindagura impapuro. Ibyumba byo kuruhukiramo byatanze ibihe byo kuruhuka, hamwe nabakozi basangira ikawa nibiganiro bisanzwe. Ikibaho cyera na ecran byerekanaga imbonerahamwe, ingengabihe yumushinga, nibitekerezo muri flux, byose bikora bigamije intego rusange. Nubwo bahuze cyane, habayeho kumva intego no guhanga udushya twasobanuye uburyo bugezweho bwo gutera imbere no gutsinda.

Gariyamoshi yuzuye yari gari ya moshi, aho inkuru zitabarika zahuriraga. Abagenzi bihutiye gufata gari ya moshi zabo, bafata imifuka n'amasakoshi, buri kimwe gifite aho kigana n'inzozi. Abacuruzi bagurishije ibiryo n'ibinyamakuru hamwe na konti y'itike byumvikana n'amajwi n'amatangazo. Ihuriro ryanyeganyega utegerezanyije amatsiko moteri yatontomye mubuzima, byerekana kugenda no kuza. Muri uyu mwanya wigihe gito, ibihe byo guhuza no gusezera bivanze, bisubiramo injyana yubuzima bwa buri munsi mwisi itigeze ihagarika kwimuka.

Imbere mu ishyamba, urumuri rw'izuba rwungurutswe mu kibabi cy'amababi, rushyira ibishushanyo mbonera ku isi yoroshye hepfo. Ibiremwa byubwoko bwose byimutse bucece binyuze aho bituye, buri kimwe kigira uruhare rwurubuga rukomeye rwubuzima. Ikirere cyari gikungahaye ku mpumuro ya mose, pinusi, n'ubutaka butose, bituma abantu bumva ko bahagaze neza. Umugezi woroheje wakomerekeje mu biti, urusaku rwarwo rukora nk'amajwi atuje agana mu butayu butuje. Ahera hegerejwe hatarakomeje kuba ikimenyetso cyuko ibidukikije bihangana nubwiza burambye bwibidukikije bidakorwa.

Igikoni cyinshi cyuzuyemo ibikorwa mugihe abatetsi bategura ibyokurya byinshi. Amajwi ahindagurika avuye mu buhanga avanze n'impumuro y'ibyatsi, ibirungo, n'umugati utetse vuba, bigatuma habaho ibidukikije bikurura. Ibikoresho byaciwe, bikaranga, kandi bikarangwamo neza, buri kimwe kigira uruhare mu guhuza uburyohe. Abakozi bimutse nta nkomyi hagati ya sitasiyo, bahuza kugirango buri sahani igerweho neza. Abashyitsi bategereje amafunguro yabo, inyubako yo gutegereza igihe ibyokurya byahurizaga hamwe - buri funguro umurimo wubuhanzi wagenewe kunezeza ibyumviro no guhaza ubugingo.

Mu ngoro y’ubuhanzi, inkuta zari zishushanyijeho ibyegeranyo bitandukanye by’amashusho, ibishusho, n’amafoto. Abashyitsi bimutse buhoro buhoro bava ku kindi, buri wese ahagarara gusobanura no gushima iyerekwa ryabahanzi. Itara ryerekanaga imiterere nibisobanuro, bizana ibihangano mubuzima. Ibiganiro bituje kubyerekeranye na tekinike, amarangamutima, nibisobanuro byongerewe uburebure kuburambe. Umwanya wari ahera ho guhanga no gutekereza, aho imbaraga zo kwerekana amashusho zashishikarizaga ibitekerezo bishya kandi bigatera gutekereza.

Mu gitondo cya kare ku cyuzi, igihu cyazamutse buhoro buhoro hejuru y’amazi, bituma habaho umwuka wa etereal. Inkongoro zasunitswe n'ubunebwe, zisiga imvururu zikurikiranye, mu gihe ibinyoni biguruka hejuru y'urubingo. Umutuzo wumuseke waciwe gusa na croon yoroshye yinyoni zindirimbo zakira umunsi. Ibiti bikikije bigaragarira mu mazi atuje, bikubye kabiri kumva umutuzo. Uyu mwanya utuje wagaragazaga ubwiza butuje bwibidukikije mbere yuko isi ikanguka byuzuye, itwibutsa injyana yamahoro irangwa nizuba risanzwe.

Amatara yikinamico yacuramye nkuko umwenda uzamuka, ugaragaza urwego rwerekanwe kumikorere itazibagirana. Abakinnyi binjiye mu nshingano zabo, bagaragaza abantu bafite ishyaka no kwizera, bazana inkuru mubuzima. Abari bateranye barumiwe, baseka kandi bakoma amashyi byerekana ibihe bibi ndetse nimpinduka zidasanzwe. Umuziki no kumurika byongereye amarangamutima nikirere, bihindura umwanya mubice byo gutekereza no kwibaza. Igikorwa kirangiye, amashyi yaradutse, yishimira ubuhanzi nimbaraga zatumye igitaramo kitazibagirana kuri bose.

Mu nkengero z'umutuzo, amazu yahagaze ku murongo mwiza, buriwese ufite ubusitani bwawo buturika n'indabyo n'icyatsi. Imihanda yari yuzuyemo isura imenyerewe kandi yunvikana urugwiro, bikagaragaza imyumvire y'abaturage n'umutekano. Abana bakiniraga mu gikari mugihe abantu bakuru bakundaga imirimo cyangwa baganira mubaraza. Hum yoroheje yubuzima bwa buri munsi yaremye ibintu bihumuriza, ashimangira akamaro k'urugo no guhuza. Umugoroba waguye, urumuri rworoheje rw'amatara y'ibaraza rwakiriye ijoro, rutura mu njyana y'amahoro y'ubuzima bwo mu mujyi.

Umuhanda wimisozi wakomerekeje hejuru unyuze ahantu habi, bigoye ba mukerarugendo bafite imisozi ihanamye kandi hejuru yubutare. Buri ntambwe isaba imbaraga no kwiyemeza, ihembwa n'ibitekerezo bitangaje muri iyo nama. Umuyaga ukonje wo mu misozi wongereye imbaraga ibyumviro, mugihe indabyo zo mu gasozi n'ibiti bikaze byiziritse ku mwobo w'urutare. Rimwe na rimwe, gutaka kwa kagoma kure cyangwa kubona ihene yo mu misozi byibukije abadiventiste ubwiza bwo mu gasozi bubakikije. Kugera ku mpinga byari umwanya wo gutsinda, gihamya yo kwihangana n'imbaraga ziteye ubwoba za kamere.

Isoko ryo mu mujyi wa kera ryari ahantu h'ibikorwa, abacuruzi bavuza induru ibicuruzwa byabo ndetse n’abakiriya baterana amagambo. Amaduka yuzuyemo ibihangano byakozwe n'intoki, ibirungo, n'imyenda, buri kintu kigereranya igice cy'umurage gakondo w'umujyi. Impumuro y'ibiryo bidasanzwe byuzuye umwuka, bigerageza abahisi guhitamo uburyohe bushya. Amajwi yumuziki n'imbyino biturutse kubahanzi bari hafi yongeyeho umwuka mwiza. Ihuriro ryuzuye ntiryari ahantu ho gucururiza; yari ihuriro ry'amateka, imigenzo, no guhuza abantu.

Munsi yikirere cya nijoro, inkongi yumuriro irabyina igicucu kibyina mumaso yabagenzi barushye. Kugabana inkuru no kuririmba indirimbo, bagaragaje umunezero woroshye wo gusabana. Umuriro ugurumana watanze ubushyuhe mukirere gikonje, mugihe inyenyeri zo hejuru zatanze canvas yo mwijuru yibitangaza bitagira iherezo. Ihamagarwa rya kure ry'igihunyira hamwe no gutontoma kwamababi byoroheje byaremye ibintu bituje. Muri kano kanya, kuzengurutswe na kamere n'inshuti, igihe cyasaga nkigihagaze, gishimangira igihe cyashize cyo kwidagadura hanze.

Ihuriro ry’amasomo ryahuje intiti zo hirya no hino ku isi kugira ngo bungurane ibitekerezo kandi baganire ku guhanga udushya. Abatanze ibiganiro nyamukuru batanze ibiganiro byubaka, bakongeza imirongo mishya yiperereza nubufatanye. Ibice byo gutandukana byashishikarije ibiganiro byungurana ibitekerezo, biteza imbere umuryango wibitekerezo byo kubaza. Kungurana ubumenyi byujujwe nibikorwa byo guhuza ibikorwa nibikorwa byumuco, bikungahaza uburambe burenze amasomo. Nkuko inama yashojwe, abitabiriye amahugurwa bagaragaje icyerekezo gishya n’ubufatanye bushoboka, bituma iterambere ryabo mu nzego zabo.

Imvura yoroheje yaguye hejuru yumujyi, ikora igikonjo cyinjyana ku madirishya no hejuru yinzu. Abanyamaguru bihutiye munsi y’umutaka, intambwe zabo zirihuta ariko ntizihute, kuko ibitekerezo byerekanaga kuri kaburimbo itose. Impumuro y'isi itose n'imvura nshya byongereye imbaraga ibyumviro, bitanga akanya ko kuvugurura hagati yubuzima bwumujyi. Amatara yo kumuhanda atera urumuri rwa zahabu, rutandukanye nikirere gikonje cyijimye, wongeyeho ubushyuhe bwiza kubibera. Gutabarwa no gutuza byasimbuye imvururu zabanje, kuko umujyi wakiriye neza imvura ituje, yibutsa abantu bose imbaraga zoroheje za kamere.

Urusengero rwa kera rwahagaze nk'ubuhamya bw'ubukorikori bw'abantu no mu mwuka, inkuta zawo z'amabuye zagiye zuzura ibinyejana byinshi umuyaga n'ikirere. Ibishushanyo binini cyane byashushanyijeho imitako, inkuru zongorerana ubwitange n'imigani. Ingenzi n'abashyitsi kimwe basanze ihumure n'imbaraga ahantu hatuje, aho guceceka no kubaha byuzuye umwuka. Kuba urusengero rwarahuzaga ibyahise nubu, bibutsa kwera umurage ndangamuco no gushaka ibisobanuro bihoraho. Nkuko urumuri rw'izuba rwungurutswe mu mwobo no mu mwobo, kumva umwanya utwikiriye urubuga.

Carnival ishimishije yari indorerwamo y'amabara, amajwi, n'ibyishimo. Kugenda byaragenze cyane, byuzuye induru zishimishije, mugihe aho bahagararaga imikino byatangaga amahirwe yo guhembwa no guseka. Abahanzi bambaye imyambarire bashimishije imbaga hamwe na acrobatics, amayeri yubumaji, nibikorwa bya muzika, bafata ibitekerezo byimyaka yose. Impumuro ya bombo ya pamba, popcorn, hamwe na sosiso zasye zashishikarije abitabiriye kwishora. Ijoro ryakeye, amatara yaka n'umuziki byateje umwuka w'ingufu wizihizaga umunezero, umuryango, n'ibinezeza byoroheje by'ubuzima.

Mu isomero rituje rituje, ameza imwe yamurikiwe n’itara, atumira umusomyi gutakaza mu gitabo. Urupapuro rwarimo isi yibitekerezo, ubumenyi, n'amarangamutima, buriwese umuryango wubwumvikane bushya cyangwa guhunga. Guceceka bidukikije byatumaga kwibanda no gutekereza, ahera kuva mu kajagari kari hanze. Hafi aho, amasahani yateguwe nisomo nuwanditse yatanze tapeste ikungahaye yibitekerezo byabantu no guhanga. Aka gace k'amatsiko kagaragaje imbaraga zihoraho zo gusoma kugirango zishishikarize, kwigisha, no guhinduka.

Uruzabibu rwarambuye imisozi izunguruka, imizabibu yayo iremereye n'inzabibu zeze ziteguye gusarurwa. Abakozi bimutse muburyo hagati yumurongo, gutema no gutoranya, buriwese yita kubutaka yitonze kandi afite ubuhanga. Izuba ryatanze ibara rya zahabu hejuru y’ahantu heza, hagaragaza icyatsi kibisi n’ibara ryijimye. Umwuka wari wuzuye impumuro nziza yimbuto nubutaka, bikubiyemo ishingiro ryubuzima bwubuhinzi. Igihe cy'isarura cyegereje, ibyifuzo byariyongereye kuri divayi itarakorwa muri ayo masoko y'agaciro.

Umujyi utwikiriwe na shelegi wari ishusho nziza cyane yubukonje, hejuru yinzu hejuru yubururu hejuru yumweru na icicles bimanikwa kuri eva. Umuhanda wari utuje, urujijo kubera kugwa kwinshi kwurubura, bituma habaho amahoro. Abana bubatse urubura kandi barwanira urubura, ibitwenge byabo byumvikanira mu kirere. Amatara ashyushye ava mu kazu no mu maduka yagereranyaga neza n’ibidukikije bikonje, bigatera akanyamuneza keza. Imiterere yose yasaga nkaho irabagirana nubumaji bwigihe, itumira abantu bose gutuza ituze ryigihe cyitumba.

Mu mujyi wuzuye icyambu, amato atwara imizigo n'ubwato bwo kuroba bwikaraga ku cyambu, masta yabo agera mu kirere. Abakozi ba Dock bakoraga vuba, bapakira kandi bapakurura ibicuruzwa byazamuye ubukungu bwumujyi kandi bugahuza nisi yagutse. Ahantu hacururizwa kumasoko kumurongo hashyizweho uburyo bushya bwo gufata, ubukorikori bwubukorikori, hamwe nibuka kubagenzi ndetse nabenegihugu. Impumuro y'amazi yumunyu, ibiryo byo mu nyanja, na mazutu bivanze mukirere, bikerekana ubuzima bwubuzima bwo mu nyanja. Igihe amato yagendaga cyangwa yahageraga, umujyi wateye imbere mu kugenda, mu bucuruzi, no ku nyanja ikurura.

Ubuhanga bwo guteka bwuzuyemo imigati yuzuye ubushyuhe, butumira impumuro yatumaga abahisi imbere. Umugati utetse neza hamwe nibyokurya byateguwe neza muburyo bwo kwerekana, ibishishwa bya zahabu hamwe nibice byoroshye bigerageza ibyumviro. Abatekera bacecetse mugihe batekaga ifu bagakora imigati, ubuhanga bwabo bugaragarira muburyo burambuye. Abakiriya bishimiye ambiance nziza, uburyohe bwo kurya hamwe nikawa cyangwa icyayi, gusangira ibiganiro kubyokurya bitetse. Ubukorikori bwo guteka ntabwo bwagaburiwe gusa ahubwo bwahujije abantu binyuze mumigenzo, guhanga, nibyishimo byoroshye byibiribwa byiza.

Hagati y'amahugurwa akomeye, abanyabukorikori bakoranye umwete imishinga yabo, buri gice kigaragaza ubuhanga n'ishyaka. Ibikoresho byatangiraga ku biti no mu cyuma kugeza ku mwenda n'ibumba, hamwe n'abanyabukorikori bahindura ibintu bibisi mu buhanzi bukora. Amajwi y'ibiti, inyundo, n'imyenda byahujwe na simfoni yo kurema. Abashyitsi bashimishijwe n'ubukorikori, akenshi bashishikarizwa gukurikirana ibikorwa byabo by'ubuhanzi. Amahugurwa yari ikimenyetso cyubwenge bwabantu hamwe nubwitange burambye bwibintu byakozwe n'intoki, bifite ireme.

Mu minsi mikuru ikomeye, ibireremba bitatse indabyo n'amatara byerekanwe mu mihanda, bishimira umurage ndangamuco n'umutima rusange. Abahanzi bambaye imyambarire barabyinnye kandi bacuranga umuziki, bashishikaza abareba imyaka yose. Ahantu hacururizwaga ibiryo byatangaga ibyokurya gakondo, bigasangira uburyohe kuva kera. Umwuka wazungurutse umunezero, ibitwenge, n'ibyishimo rusange byo kwitabira. Ijoro ryakeye, imirishyo yaka ikirere, iranga indunduro y'ibintu bishimishije, bitazibagirana byahuje abantu mu birori.

Icyaro gituje cyari agace k'imirima n'amashyamba, aho igihe cyasaga nkicyatinze. Abahinzi bakunze guhinga n’amatungo, gahunda zabo zashinze imizi mu binyejana byakera. Imidugudu mito yubatswe hagati yicyatsi, hamwe nakazu kagaragazaga igikundiro. Amajwi yoroheje ya kamere - inyoni ziririmba, umuyaga uhuhuta mumababi, moo ya kure ya kure - yaremye amajwi atuje. Iyi myidagaduro idatanga umwiherero uva mu mibereho yo mu mijyi, yibutsa abashyitsi amahoro n'ubworoherane biboneka mu guhobera ibidukikije.

Mu bitaro bigezweho, inzobere mu buvuzi zakoze ubudacogora kugira ngo zite ku barwayi, ubwitange bwabo bugaragarira mu bimenyetso byose. Ibidukikije bidafite aho bihurira n’ibikorwa, abaforomo n’abaganga bahuza imiti no gukurikirana ibimenyetso byingenzi. Ikoranabuhanga ryateye imbere ryoroheje gusuzuma no gukira, bikubiyemo guhuza impuhwe no guhanga udushya. Abarwayi babonye ihumure mu buhanga n'ubugwaneza bw'abakozi, bizeye intego yabo yo kugarura ubuzima n'imibereho myiza. Uyu mwanya wari igihamya cyo kwihangana kwabantu no gukomeza gukira.

Ubutayu bwarambuye ubuziraherezo, igice kinini cy'umusenyi n'ibibaya bitare munsi y'izuba ryaka. Ibimera bya Cacti nibikomeye byiziritse kubuzima muri ibi bidukikije, kwihangana kwabo gutera ubwoba. Abagenzi bagendeye kuri ubwo bwitonzi, bazi akaga n'ubwiza buvanze muri ubu butayu. Mirage yatigise kure, ibishushanyo byakinaga amaso ariko byongera amayobera yimiterere. Izuba rirenze ryahinduye ubutayu mo urumuri rutukura n'umucunga, ibintu byerekana igihe gito imbaraga zidasanzwe za kamere n'ubwiza buhebuje.

Akazu keza kari hagati y'ibiti birebire byatanze ubuturo bwera ku isi yo hanze. Amashyiga yatwitse, atera urumuri rushyushye rwuzuza imitako ya rustic. Abashyitsi buzuye ibitabo cyangwa inkuru basangiye, bishimira ituze ryumwiherero wabo. Hanze, shelegi yaguye yitonze, itwikiriye ubuso bwera, mugihe imbere, ubushyuhe no guhumurizwa byiganje. Iyi miterere yimbitse yagaragazaga umwiherero mubworoherane no guhumurizwa biboneka mumatako ya kamere, guhunga neza kuruhuka no gusubirana imbaraga.

Mu nzu yimyidagaduro yumujyi, abakinnyi bateguye inyuma yinyuma, imitsi yabo nibyishimo birashoboka. Orchestre yahinduye ibikoresho byabo amashyi n'ibiganiro byuzuye muri salle. Iyo umwenda uzamutse, stade yahindutse isi yikinamico, urwenya, cyangwa ibyago, ishimisha abayireba kandi itanga ibisubizo byamarangamutima. Ubumwe bwimikorere - abakinnyi, abacuranzi, abakozi ba stage - bakoze igihangano cyigihe gito cyabayeho muri ako kanya. Mugihe igice cya nyuma cyasojwe no gukomera amashyi, amarozi yikinamico yibukije buri wese imbaraga zo kuvuga inkuru no kwerekana abantu.

Ikigo cy'abihaye Imana gifite amahoro cyari ahantu ho gutekereza no gutuza. Abihayimana bagenda bucece banyuze muri cloisters, barera ubusitani kandi bitegura amasengesho ya buri munsi. Impumuro yimibavu nindabyo zirabya byiyongereye kuri ambiance yumwuka, bitera gutekereza no gutuza. Abashyitsi cyangwa abahatuye babonye ihumure mu bworoherane na disipulini y'ubuzima bwa monasitike, aho gutekereza hamwe n'abaturage. Yashizwe mu muco gakondo umaze ibinyejana byinshi, uyu mwanya wera watangaga ubuturo bwera mu gihe cy'akaduruvayo k'isi.

Ahantu hubatswe cyane, abakozi bahujije imbaraga zo kubaka urwego rushya, buri wese atanga ubumenyi. Gufatanya ibyuma hamwe na hum yimashini byerekanaga iterambere, mugihe protocole yumutekano yarindaga abantu bose umutekano. Ibikoresho byageze mumigezi ihamye - beto, ibiti by'ibyuma, amatafari - buri gice cyingenzi mubusugire bwumushinga. Abubatsi naba injeniyeri bagenzuye umurimo, bareba ko igishushanyo cyakozwe mu budahemuka. Urubuga rwari ikimenyetso cyifuzo cyabantu nimbaraga zifatanije zisabwa kugirango gahunda zibe impamo.

Ibinyabuzima bya korali bifite imbaraga byuzuye ubuzima munsi yubutaka bwamazi meza. Amashuri y amafi yamabara yashushanyije mumashami ya korali, mugihe inyenzi nziza zo mu nyanja zanyuze kera. Ibinyabuzima byo mu nyanja bigoye cyane byashyigikiraga amoko menshi, buri kimwe kigira uruhare runini mu gukomeza kuringaniza. Snorkelers hamwe nabashitsi bakoze ubushakashatsi kuri iyi paradizo yo mumazi, batangazwa nubwiza bwayo nubwinshi. Kurinda uturere tworoshye byari ingenzi mu kubungabunga ubutunzi bwubuzima bwo mu nyanja ibisekuruza bizaza.

Mu rusengero rw’Ababuda rutuje, abihayimana bakoze imihango no gutekereza, bituma habaho umwuka wo gutuza no kwibanda ku mwuka. Impumuro yimibavu yazengurukaga mu kirere igihe induru yumvikanaga buhoro, ikayobora abimenyereza imbere. Ibishusho n'amashusho yimana byatanze ingingo yibanze kumasengesho no gutekereza, biteza imbere guhuza no kubaha. Abashyitsi bashaka amahoro n'ubushishozi babonye ihumure mu rusengero rutuje. Ahantu hatagatifu habaye ahantu ho gushakisha imbere no gutsimbataza impuhwe.

Ikibuga cyiza cya ski cyuzuyemo ibikorwa byinshi mugihe abasiganwa ku maguru hamwe n’abasiganwa ku rubura bagendaga ahantu h'urubura no mu mayira yo mu misozi. Intebe zo hejuru zajyanye abashyitsi ku mpinga, zitanga ibyerekezo nyaburanga byuzuye urubura. Nyuma yumunsi wo kwidagadura, abashyitsi bateraniye mu icumbi ryiza, basangira inkuru kandi bishyushya umuriro waka. Impumuro ya shokora ishushe hamwe nifunguro ryuzuye byuzuye umwuka, bituma urwego rukurikira rwibyishimo. Ikibuga cyimikino yo mu itumba cyari ibirori bya adrenaline, kamere, nubusabane, bituma habaho kwibuka nyuma yigihe urubura rushonga.

Muri laboratoire ihanitse, abahanga bakoze ubushakashatsi bwitondewe, bashingiye ku busobanuro n'ubuhanga. Ibikoresho byacanye munsi y’amatara yaka igihe basesenguye ingero bakandika amakuru, bagashaka ubushishozi ku isi karemano cyangwa iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga. Ubufatanye n'amatsiko byatumaga akazi kabo, akenshi biganisha ku ntambwe zishobora kugira ingaruka kuri societe neza. Ibidukikije byari uruvange rwa gahunda igenzurwa nubushakashatsi butagira umupaka, bikubiyemo umwuka wabantu wo kuvumbura no guhanga udushya. Ibisubizo byose byagize uruhare mubushakashatsi bunini bwo gusobanukirwa no gutera imbere.

Amaduka meza yibitabo kumuhanda mukuru yahamagariye abakunzi b'ibitabo hamwe na feri yayo itumira hamwe n'amasahani yaturitsemo amajwi. Basomyi barebye neza ibyegeranyo byateguwe neza, bavumbura abanditsi bashya hamwe nigihe cyakera kimwe. Impumuro yimpapuro zishaje zahishe abashyitsi, byongera umunezero wa tactile yo kuvumbura inkuru nubumenyi. Abakozi b'inshuti batanze ibyifuzo, bongeraho gukoraho kuburambe. Iki kibanza cyubuvanganzo cyateje imbere umuryango, gutekereza, no kwiga, bikomeza isano iri hagati yamagambo nabayikunda.

Mu busitani bwibimera bwagutse, ibimera bitoshye byo hirya no hino ku isi byerekanwe mu bice byateguwe neza. Inzira zanyuze mu buriri bwindabyo zifite imbaraga, ibyuzi bya tranquil, na arboretum igicucu, bitumira ubushakashatsi numutuzo. Abarimyi bakunze urukundo kuri buri gihingwa, bakarinda kubungabunga amoko adasanzwe n'ubwiza bw'ahantu nyaburanga. Abashyitsi batangajwe n’ibimera bitandukanye, biga ku mibanire y’ibidukikije n’ubuhinzi bw’imboga. Ubusitani bwabaye ahera kubantu bamenyereye ndetse nabashya kimwe, kaseti nzima yibitangaza bya kamere n'ubuhanga bwa muntu.

Parike ishimishije cyane yatangaga ibishimishije kandi bikonje hamwe na coaster yayo, ibiziga bya Ferris, nimikino. Amatara yaka numuziki unezerewe byateje umwuka wimbaraga ukurura abantu baturutse hafi na kure. Abana ndetse nabakuze bahuye nibihe byibyishimo no kwishima, gufata ibyibukwa mugihe gishimishije nubusa. Ibicuruzwa byemewe byatanze ibintu byose uhereye kuri bombo ya pamba kugeza ibiryohereye, bikongerera imbaraga. Iki gitaramo cyo kwidagadura no gusetsa cyizihije ubworoherane n'ibyishimo byo kwidagadura utitaye, byibutsa buri wese umunezero uboneka mubyababayeho.

Mu icumbi rituje ryo mu cyaro, abashyitsi bishimiye umwiherero w’amahoro uva mu buzima bwa buri munsi. Ibikoresho bya rustic hamwe n'amatara ashyushye byateje ambiance nziza, mugihe amafunguro meza yatangaga ihumure nibitunga. Ahantu nyaburanga hagaragayemo imirima izunguruka n'amashyamba atuje, meza yo kugenda no gutekereza. Kwakira abacumbitsi byatumaga bumva ko ari ababo kandi baruhutse, bituma abashyitsi bumva bari mu rugo. Aka gace k'ubworoherane na kamere byatanze akaruhuko gashya, guhuza abagenzi n'umuvuduko gahoro, nkana mubuzima bwicyaro.

Inzu ndangamurage nziza, igezweho yerekanaga ibintu byinshi bitandukanye byubuhanzi, amateka, na siyansi. Abashyitsi bimukiye mubyerekanwe neza, bashushanya nibintu bikorana hamwe nibisobanuro byamakuru. Ubwubatsi ubwabwo bwari umurimo wubuhanzi, burimo igishushanyo mbonera cyo kuzuza ibyerekanwe imbere. Gahunda zuburezi nibikorwa bidasanzwe byateje amatsiko no kwiga. Inzu ndangamurage yabaye nk'ikiraro gihuza ibyahise, iby'ubu, n'ibizaza, bikangurira abashyitsi gushima ibihangano bya muntu n'ubuhanga mu bumenyi.

Ku musozi utuje, ishapeli ntoya yirengagije imiterere ikikije, umusozi wacyo ugera mu kirere. Ingenzi n'abashyitsi baje gushaka ihumure, gusenga, cyangwa kwishimira gusa ibyerekanwe. Urukuta rw'amabuye n'imbere byoroheje byerekanaga kwicisha bugufi no kubaha, bitera ibihe byo gutekereza no guhuza. Imiterere yari yibukije abantu kwihangana gukurikira gukura kwumwuka no gusobanukirwa. Iyo izuba rirenze, ishapeli yagaragaye nk'itara ry'amizero n'amahoro hagati y'ibidukikije.
